decisions: Reuse monitor_math no-follow byte reader and comment/string masker; reject unsafe or unstable source reads.
Snapshots keep every source path occurrence and explicit unknown-unreplayed proof status; graph edges never promote proof acceptance.
Source roles bind existing docs/math-layout.json and evidence/source-intake.json entries; uncataloged Git-visible Lean files remain candidate-source-only.
Taxonomy stays separate; adapter does not interpret method-facet edges as imports or formal implications.
integration_contract: Will expose snapshot/revise, verify (--live), status, expand; stdlib Python 3.9; immutable SHA-addressed compressed source bytes and manifests plus CAS refs.
